_note: Season Shop money offers — Naira only, same rules as topup-packages.json (never purchasable with Solars/gems). Distinct from the in-game-currency Season Shop (.season shop), which spends Season Points. These are themed, limited-time bundles surfaced only via `.season offer`, DM-only. IDs are CAPS 'PREFIX-NAME' (GEM- for gem bundles, SOL- for solar bundles, low to high); buy lookup in plugins/season.js is case-insensitive so players can type any case. Edit priceNaira/gems/solars freely — nothing else in the code depends on the numbers.
